aggregate_scope: Workload aggregate; exposed diagnostics and fresh families must be assessed separately.
cost_interpretation: Request wall time includes local parsing and execution validation; preparation costs are measured separately. Snapshot compilation counts only actual compilations, excluding cached zero-cost entries. Shared-host measurements are descriptive, not service-load SLOs.
inference_unit: case; shared documents, semantic families and conditions are not independent samples
limitations: Fresh documents and glossary worlds are AI authored and AI reviewed, not human gold or actual workplace records.
Pipeline selectors expose their own retrieved facts; plain versus KTRF is a product comparison, not a matched-information formatting test.
Applicability metadata is supplied identically to all arms and is source-authored entity metadata, never case gold.
The experimental evidence gate checks literal source and occurrence consistency, not general semantic entailment or a deployment-risk guarantee.
Compact responses are expanded only through an immutable per-request binding; production occurrence authorization remains required.
All sources and facts remain complete; overlong prompts fail preparation instead of being clipped.
Fresh family clusters, not repeated arms or model calls, are the statistical units.
metric_interpretation: Raw semantic selection and occurrence-bound approval are separate; synthetic/public proxy samples do not certify deployment risk.
